title: "Claustrum Connectivity in Prematurity Covariate-Adjusted Effect Sizes (Table S13, Figure 3)"
author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html

editor_options:

---

Covariate-adjusted Cohen's d for the group differences (FT - PT) in CP and CD per target ROI, in both cohorts. d = ANCOVA-adjusted mean difference (group + age at scan + sex) divided by the pooled within-group SD, with 95% CI; unadjusted d is computed for comparison. FDR correction across the 22 target ROIs per cohort and metric.

- Input: `data/adults_harmonized.csv`, `data/dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv`, `data/dHCP_CD_cog_ses.csv`, `data/effect_size_trajectory_mod.csv` (ROI order and labels for Figure 3)
- Outputs:
  - `outputs/tables/Revision_TableS13_adjusted_d_<date>.csv`: Table S13 (results/effect_sizes_adjusted_d.csv)
  - `data/effect_size_trajectory_CP_ADJ_<date>.csv`, `data/effect_size_trajectory_CD_ADJ_<date>.csv`: adjusted d per ROI, input for `Revision_3_1_1_metric_agreement.qmd`
  - `data/Figure3_input_adjusted_d.csv`: input for Figure 3 (`trajectory.qmd`)

tab_dir  <- here::here("outputs", "tables")

cov_bls  <- c("age_at_scan", "sex")
cov_dhcp <- c("scan_age", "sex")

### Load data

```{r}
# --- BLS (harmonized) ---
dat <- read_delim(
  file.path(data_dir, "adults_harmonized.csv"),
  delim = ";", trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(Subject = col_character(), ID = col_character()),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(groupcode == 0 ~ "FT", groupcode == 1 ~ "PT"),
                   levels = c("FT", "PT")),
    sex   = factor(case_when(sex == 1 ~ "Male", sex == 2 ~ "Female"),
                   levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

# --- dHCP ---
load_dHCP <- function(file) {
  readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, file), na = c("", "NA", "NaN"),
                  show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    janitor::clean_names() |>
    mutate(
      group = factor(dplyr::recode(group, term = "FT", pre = "PT"), levels = c("FT", "PT")),
      sex   = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
    )
}
dat_dHCP_cp <- load_dHCP("dHCP_CP_cog_ses.csv")
dat_dHCP_cd <- load_dHCP("dHCP_CD_cog_ses.csv")

# --- checks ---
cp_vars_bls   <- names(roi_labels)
cd_vars_bls   <- names(roi_labels_CD)
roi_cols_dHCP <- names(roi_labels_dHCP)

stopifnot(
  all(c(cp_vars_bls, cd_vars_bls, cov_bls) %in% names(dat)),
  all(c(roi_cols_dHCP, cov_dhcp) %in% names(dat_dHCP_cp)),
  all(c(roi_cols_dHCP, cov_dhcp) %in% names(dat_dHCP_cd)),
  !anyNA(dat$group), !anyNA(dat_dHCP_cp$group)
)
```

## 2 Effect size functions

```{r}
d_one <- function(data, dv, covars) {
  fml <- reformulate(c("group", covars), response = dv)
  df  <- data[, c(dv, "group", covars)] |> na.omit()
  fit <- lm(fml, data = df)

  # ANCOVA group test
  a3   <- as.data.frame(car::Anova(fit, type = 3))
  p    <- a3[["Pr(>F)"]][rownames(a3) == "group"]
  Fval <- a3[["F value"]][rownames(a3) == "group"]
  df2  <- a3[["Df"]][rownames(a3) == "Residuals"]

  # Adjusted mean difference FT - PT with 95% CI
  ct <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ group) |>
    emmeans::contrast(method = "pairwise") |>
    summary(infer = TRUE)
  stopifnot(nrow(ct) == 1, grepl("FT - PT", ct$contrast))

  # Pooled within-group SD of the outcome
  x1 <- df[[dv]][df$group == "FT"]; x2 <- df[[dv]][df$group == "PT"]
  n1 <- length(x1); n2 <- length(x2)
  sp <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * var(x1) + (n2 - 1) * var(x2)) / (n1 + n2 - 2))

  # Unadjusted d
  d_u  <- (mean(x1) - mean(x2)) / sp
  se_u <- sqrt((n1 + n2) / (n1 * n2) + d_u^2 / (2 * (n1 + n2)))

  tibble(
    roi_code = dv, n_FT = n1, n_PT = n2,
    d_unadj = d_u, ci_lo_unadj = d_u - 1.96 * se_u, ci_hi_unadj = d_u + 1.96 * se_u,
    diff_adj = ct$estimate,
    d_adj    = ct$estimate / sp,
    ci_lo_adj = ct$lower.CL / sp,
    ci_hi_adj = ct$upper.CL / sp,
    F = Fval, df2 = df2, p = p
  )
}

d_tbl <- function(data, vars, labels, covars, cohort, metric) {
  map_dfr(vars, ~ d_one(data, .x, covars)) |>
    mutate(ROI = unname(labels[roi_code]),
           cohort = cohort, metric = metric,
           p_FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "fdr"),
           .before = 1)
}
```

## 3 Compute

```{r}
es <- bind_rows(
  d_tbl(dat,         cp_vars_bls,   roi_labels,      cov_bls,  "BLS",  "CP"),
  d_tbl(dat,         cd_vars_bls,   roi_labels_CD,   cov_bls,  "BLS",  "CD"),
  d_tbl(dat_dHCP_cp, roi_cols_dHCP, roi_labels_dHCP, cov_dhcp, "dHCP", "CP"),
  d_tbl(dat_dHCP_cd, roi_cols_dHCP, roi_labels_dHCP, cov_dhcp, "dHCP", "CD")
)
stopifnot(nrow(es) == 88, !anyNA(es$ROI), !anyNA(es$d_adj))
```

## 4 Save outputs

```{r}
stamp <- format(Sys.Date())

fmt_ci <- function(d, lo, hi) sprintf("%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]", d, lo, hi)
tab_s13 <- es |>
  filter(metric == "CP") |>
  transmute(ROI, cohort,
            d_adj_ci   = fmt_ci(d_adj, ci_lo_adj, ci_hi_adj),
            d_unadj_ci = fmt_ci(d_unadj, ci_lo_unadj, ci_hi_unadj),
            p_FDR) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = cohort, values_from = c(d_adj_ci, d_unadj_ci, p_FDR),
              names_glue = "{cohort}_{.value}") |>
  select(ROI, starts_with("dHCP_"), starts_with("BLS_"))

write_csv2(tab_s13, file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_TableS13_adjusted_d_", stamp, ".csv")))

to_wide <- function(m) {
  es |> filter(metric == m) |>
    transmute(ROI, cohort, d = d_adj, ci_lo = ci_lo_adj, ci_hi = ci_hi_adj, p = p_FDR) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = cohort, values_from = c(d, ci_lo, ci_hi, p),
                names_glue = "{cohort}_{.value}")
}
d_traj_cp_adj <- to_wide("CP")
d_traj_cd_adj <- to_wide("CD")
write_csv2(d_traj_cp_adj, file.path(data_dir, paste0("effect_size_trajectory_CP_ADJ_", stamp, ".csv")))
write_csv2(d_traj_cd_adj, file.path(data_dir, paste0("effect_size_trajectory_CD_ADJ_", stamp, ".csv")))
```

## 5 Generate input file for figure 3

```{r}
roi_codes <- c(
  "Occipital Associative (R)" = "AC_Occ_R",  "Occipital Associative (L)" = "AC_Occ_L",
  "Parietal Associative (R)"  = "AC_Par_R",  "Parietal Associative (L)"  = "AC_Par_L",
  "Prefrontal Associative (R)"= "AC_PFC_R",  "Prefrontal Associative (L)"= "AC_PFC_L",
  "Temporal Associative (R)"  = "AC_Temp_R", "Temporal Associative (L)"  = "AC_Temp_L",
  "Primary Auditory (R)"      = "PC_aud_R",  "Primary Auditory (L)"      = "PC_aud_L",
  "Primary Motor (R)"         = "PC_mot_R",  "Primary Motor (L)"         = "PC_mot_L",
  "Primary Somatosensory (R)" = "PC_sens_R", "Primary Somatosensory (L)" = "PC_sens_L",
  "Primary Visual (R)"        = "PC_vis_R",  "Primary Visual (L)"        = "PC_vis_L",
  "Anterior Cingulate (R)"    = "C_ant_R",   "Anterior Cingulate (L)"    = "C_ant_L",
  "Posterior Cingulate (R)"   = "C_pos_R",   "Posterior Cingulate (L)"   = "C_pos_L",
  "Hippocampus (R)"           = "Hip_R",     "Hippocampus (L)"           = "Hip_L"
)
layout <- read_delim(file.path(data_dir, "effect_size_trajectory_mod.csv"), delim = ";",
                     trim_ws = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(ROI, ROI_order, ROI_label, Type) |>
  mutate(ROI_label = trimws(ROI_label))
stopifnot(setequal(names(roi_codes), d_traj_cp_adj$ROI),
          setequal(unname(roi_codes), layout$ROI))

fig3 <- d_traj_cp_adj |>
  transmute(ROI = unname(roi_codes[ROI]),
            BLS_d,  BLS_p_FDR  = BLS_p,  BLS_ci_low  = BLS_ci_lo,  BLS_ci_high  = BLS_ci_hi,
            dHCP_d, dHCP_p_FDR = dHCP_p, dHCP_ci_low = dHCP_ci_lo, dHCP_ci_high = dHCP_ci_hi) |>
  right_join(layout, by = "ROI") |>
  select(ROI, ROI_order, ROI_label, Type, starts_with("BLS_"), starts_with("dHCP_")) |>
  arrange(desc(ROI_order))
stopifnot(nrow(fig3) == 22, !anyNA(fig3))
write_delim(fig3, file.path(data_dir, "Figure3_input_adjusted_d.csv"), delim = ";")
```
